mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.parent_id AS parentCommentId, c.comment_content AS commentContent, CAST(u.users_id AS CHAR) AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, c.comment_created_at AS createdAt FROM `comment` c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.users_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.comment_created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE `comment` SET comment_content = #{commentContent}, comment_modified_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
